length_definition.words: Unicode word sequences, retaining internal apostrophes/curly apostrophes/hyphens; regex in validate.py
length_definition.ties: first supplied option wins max/min; rank interval is 1-based descending, all tie positions retained
length_definition.chance: Mean reciprocal arity; descriptive uniform-choice reference, not a significance test

semantic_review.basis: Direct teacher authoring after reading all 240 parent source requests; same-session self-review only.

limitations: Same-teacher semantic self-review, not independent correctness verification.
No immutable teacher revision or sampling parameters exposed.
No model/tokenizer load; downstream token-budget audit remains necessary.
Deduplication scope is this shard and its parent lineage only.
No final/evaluation or other-producer data opened. No global deduplication or tokenization audit.
Length diagnostics are descriptive; no relabeling, state edits or reshuffling to optimize them.
